lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately six vertical columns of three to four spots each, situated between the posterior gill slit and the first dorsal fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with the circular spot columns, forming a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal linear features on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp luminance transition from high (top) to low (bottom).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, faint high-luminance blobs localized on the posterior half of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch is visible on the posterior margin of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: An elongated secondary biological silhouette is attached to the ventral region posterior to the pectoral fin base.
